title: Box breathing
description: Breathe in for 4 counts, hold for 4, out for 4, hold for 4. Repeat for a few minutes to settle your nervous system.

title: Body scan
description: Lie or sit comfortably and slowly move your attention from your toes to your head, noticing tension without judging it.

title: 5-4-3-2-1 grounding
description: Name 5 things you can see, 4 you can touch, 3 you can hear, 2 you can smell, and 1 you can taste.

title: Three good things
description: Write down three things that went well today and why they happened.

title: One mindful minute
description: Set a timer for one minute and simply notice your breath. When your mind wanders, gently come back.

title: Savor a good moment
description: Pick one pleasant moment from today and replay it in detail for a minute. Notice how it feels.

title: Gentle 10-minute walk
description: Step outside for an easy walk. No pace goals, just movement and fresh air.

title: Desk stretch break
description: Roll your shoulders, stretch your neck side to side, and reach your arms overhead. Release built-up tension.

title: Short yoga flow
description: Follow a beginner-friendly 15-minute yoga flow focused on slow movement and breathing.

title: Brisk 20-minute workout
description: Get your heart rate up with a jog, bike ride, or bodyweight circuit. Channel good energy into movement.

title: Two-song dance break
description: Put on two songs you love and move however you like.

title: Time in nature
description: Spend time in a park or green space. Leave your phone in your pocket and notice your surroundings.

title: Digital sunset
description: Turn off screens an hour before bed tonight. Read, stretch, or listen to music instead.

title: Reach out to someone
description: Send a message or call a friend or family member you trust. A short chat counts.

title: Water and a nourishing snack
description: Drink a glass of water and have a snack with some protein or fruit. Basics first.

title: Set one small boundary
description: Pick one thing to say no to or postpone this week, and protect that time for rest.

title: Plan something to look forward to
description: Put a small, enjoyable activity on your calendar for the next few days.

title: An early night
description: Aim to be in bed 30 minutes earlier than usual tonight. Rest is productive.
